statement: A domestic corporation must file its corporate tax base and amount return with the district tax office within three months from the last day of the month in which its business year ends, or four months where a faithful-return confirmation under Article 60-2(1) is filed (Corporate Tax Act Article 60(1)). The return must attach the statutory financial statements and the tax adjustment statement (Article 60(2)), and filing is required even for a year with no income or a loss (Article 60(3)).
caveat: Returns are filed through the National Tax Service’s Hometax in practice; interim prepayment and withholding duties run on separate clocks under their own articles, and a return missing the required financial statements or adjustment statement is treated as not filed (Article 60(5)).
